verdict.rationale: Heap documents a User Deletion API that submits up to 10,000 users per request and returns a deletion_request_id, so programmatic deletion is a direct capability. Retention appears only as fixed plan-tier data history (6 or 12 months), with no documented user-configurable retention control. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods/policies, deletion status tracking or completion guarantees, event- or property-level deletion, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Submits users to be deleted from Heap, and returns a unique identifier for the request (`deletion_request_id`). Up to 10,000 users can be submitted in a single request.
